description.purpose: Tools need real files; a file space keeps blocks and versions. The projection lays one workspace out as a directory under the owner's `base_path` (after the first time only what changed), runs one permitted program in it without a shell, and afterwards reads the directory once: a changed file is taken over into the workspace at once when the program is a formatter (`auto_adopt`), everything else becomes a numbered proposal that `ws_adopt` takes over. Every byte goes back through the space's `in_write` with the workspace; the projection never touches the space's tables. Since 1.1.0 ([#980](https://github.com/mmeyerlein/meclaw/issues/980)) `ws_export_git` and `ws_push` take the root form (`root` without `hop.ws`, a push names only a configured remote), `ws_exec` echoes `argv` and an export its `subject`, the bare repositories live under `git_dir` outside `base_path`, an export right after a pull moves HEAD onto the upstream and commits nothing, and a push to a local remote under `base_path` is `remote_inside_base`. A caller can rely on what was never promised before, so it is the second digit.
description.use_when: As the child hive `./projection` of a `file-space`; the owner sets `base_path` and the sandbox's write grant for `mat` and `run` in one override, and `exec_allow` for the programs that may run.
description.not_in_scope: No tool for a model (the operations are an API, not a menu); no watcher or polling; no network for a program; no default `base_path` and no write grant in the template; no cleanup of a directory after its workspace closed.
examples: PORTS - every endpoint is the HIVE path (`params.ports` is empty). Entry on `hop.route`: in_proj, in_answer. Exit: answer, in_ws, in_read, in_write.

OVERRIDE - the owner, on the ref that instantiates the file space: {"projection/mat": {"base_path": "/srv/projection", "exec_allow": ["cargo"], "sandbox": {"trust": "restricted", "network": "deny", "filesystem": {"runtime": true, "write": ["/srv/projection"]}}}, "projection/run": {"base_path": "/srv/projection", "sandbox": {...the same...}}}. Without it every request answers `no_base_path`.

RUN - {"op": "ws_exec", "args": {"argv": ["cargo", "fmt"]}} with hop `ws` answers `{run, exit, out_tail, err_tail, adopted: [{path, version}], proposals: [{id, path, kind}]}`; `ws_adopt` with `{run, ids}` takes proposals over.
